body:
## Outcome

Deliver the complete reviewed v0.92.2 planning package and create every issue in its 69-task execution plan, one independently reviewed sprint batch at a time, so CodeFriend Beta 1 can be implemented and proved through the milestone.

## Scope

Preserve the eight atomic task-family splits, eleven tightened completion contracts, all seven required planning tasks and every retained baseline obligation. Each task must deliver one complete usable result with concrete acceptance and executed validation appropriate to that result. Schemas, scaffolds, unspecified slices and unevaluated packets do not satisfy implementation or qualification work.

Create the 60 new issues across the eleven recorded creation batches and reconcile the nine existing task issues. Every issue must have a unique canonical identity, full reviewed body, milestone/version metadata and numeric execution prerequisites. Create PUB-CSDLC as the ordinary iterative manuscript revision task: author feedback is handled during the work, delivering this milestone's complete reviewed manuscript version; later revisions remain expected.

## Acceptance

- [ ] All 69 core tasks have unique GitHub issues; no missing tasks or duplicates remain, and no additional sprint umbrella issues are invented.
- [ ] Every creation batch receives independent draft review before native creation and independent live-body review before the next batch is created. All actionable findings are resolved.
- [ ] The nine existing tasks retain their complete scope and receive current milestone, label, dependency and scheduling reconciliation with authenticated native receipts and fresh readbacks.
- [ ] Every active planning document, execution wave/specification, atomic contract, WBS, catalog, sprint/readiness and release projection agrees with the final issue map.
- [ ] The global implementation-start gate requires all 69 core task identities and their completed issue reviews; it adds no artificial all-to-all task dependencies. Each task must subsequently satisfy its own native readiness and execution prerequisites.
- [ ] CF-INTEGRATE precedes independent CF-PROOF qualification. TAIL-10 explicitly requires TAIL-09, OBS-S3 and ARCH-ADR completion, and validation rejects removal or weakening of those requirements.
- [ ] Planning and launch contract checks, negative fixtures, native six-card validation, relative links and diff hygiene pass. Independent exact-head review precedes PR publication, and tracked review/execution records accurately identify completed review and remaining implementation.

## Sidecar

Existing #671 is assigned to v0.92.2 as a sidecar. It is separate from the 69-task execution graph and startup denominator and retains its own public-launch/provider-submission approval requirements. Milestone association is not execution or publication authorization.

## Boundaries

No implementation starts during this issue-creation session. Issue creation and planning evidence do not prove a working Beta 1. Do not claim runtime/provider qualification, paid execution, deployment, public publication, merge or release acceptance from this work. The milestone's product tasks must deliver working execution and independent qualification before closeout.

## Evidence and validation

Canonical source: `docs/milestones/v0.92.2/`. Creation/review evidence: `.csdlc/evidence/864/sprint01-launch/` through `sprint11-launch/`, `all-issue-launch.json`, existing issue reconciliation and sidecar receipts.

Run `python3 docs/milestones/v0.92.2/validate_planning.py --self-test`, each retained issue-launch validator, native v3 six-card validation and focused link/diff checks. Use native v3 GitHub actions for mutations and exact authenticated readback for verification.

Owned paths: `docs/milestones/v0.92.2/**`, `.csdlc/issues/864/**`, `.csdlc/evidence/864/**` and native transaction records. PR #865 uses `Closes #864`. Earlier first-batch-only scope described that completed phase and is superseded by the operator's instruction to create and review all sprints.

## Execution sprint assignment

**Sprint 1** in `docs/milestones/v0.92.2/SPRINT_v0.92.2.md`. This assignment includes the existing issue in the complete 69-task execution schedule. It creates no new issue or dependency edge; existing prerequisites, same-sprint dependency order, native readiness and the all-69 creation/review startup gate remain in force.
